verses.en: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.sm: Le ALN e, ia e laveai mai ia te au i laugutu pepelo,

verses.en: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.sm: ma le laulaufaiva e faa‘ole‘ole. Le lauliufaiva faa‘ole‘ole e, se a se mea e tuuina atu ia te oe?

verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.sm: se a foi se mea e faaopoopoina ia te oe? O u mzamaai a le tagata malosi,

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.sm: atoa ma malala ola o le ratami. Auc afu nei!

verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.sm: aua ou te awnau i Meseko, ma ou nofo i fale ie o Kitara. Ua leva ona ou nofo faatasi

verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.sm: ma 12 ua ʻinoʻino i le filemu. O aʻu nei e filemu lava au;

verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.sm: a o i latou, a aʻu tautala atu, e fia tau i latou.
